compose: // Use OpenMultipleDocuments with caller-owned accepted MIME types and retained selection.
// Stored-file selection uses named checkboxes and an explicit Choose button.
// Render local PDF pages with PdfRenderer; cancel outdated rendering and expose extracted text.
// AlertDialog confirms a version restore; show progress until model.restore completes.
views: // ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT lets people attach device files without implicit upload.
// Bind server folders to a retained tree/list selection, never a device URI picker.
// PdfRenderer.Page renders into a bitmap; page/zoom controls and extracted text stay accessible.
// MaterialAlertDialogBuilder confirms restore before an asynchronous repository write.
